rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, inspected the user’s orders, identified both tablets, and ultimately submitted the correct return for the 128GB gold tablet with refund to the gift card. The tool result confirms the return was requested on the correct item and refund method. However, policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before performing any order-changing action. After the user changed their mind, the agent executed the return immediately without restating the action and obtaining a confirmation to proceed. Despite the accurate execution and final info, this lack of explicit pre-action confirmation violates the pass criteria.
